description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Files Tab: Added Follow to text file previews. It works like tail -F, useful when looking at logs
- Files Tab: You can now select several files with Cmd+Click (Ctrl+Click), Shift+Click or Cmd+A (Ctrl+A), then download them all as one .tar
- Windows: Added a native ARM64 build for Windows. Let me know if something doesn't work, it's pretty fresh and not tested that much
💎 Improvements
- Change Protection: The Files tab now needs an unlock on protected contexts and isn't available on read-only ones
- Proxies: Added support for socks5h:// proxy URLs
🐞 Fixes
- Context Selector: The search field is now focused every time you go back to switch context, not only the first time #593
- Kubeconfig: Fixed a bug where a cluster whose server has no scheme, like 10.0.0.1:6443, couldn't connect. It now picks https or http the way kubectl does
